_doc: GUARDIAN failure taxonomy: one class per failure mechanism, each with its solution card (pain -> solution). Rules are tier 1 (free, deterministic); Jev reads free text the rules miss. Add a class only when the eval set shows a real miss; prefer merging classes (subtract before you add).

ci-runner-dead.desc: A CI runner registration, daemon, runner container or its network bridge is down, so jobs for its labels cannot start.

card.root_cause_question: Why did the runner die: a daemon restart, a deleted bridge, an IP change or OOM? Read the daemon journal before restarting anything.
card.smallest_safe_fix: Restart the runner through its normal unit or container after the cause is known (playbook 08 step 3). Never kill active jobs.
card.guard: estate-guardian ci guard: runner registrations, daemons, containers and bridges every 5 min

ci-capacity.desc: CI work cannot progress: runs wait for a runner or label, jobs hang, orphan job containers pile up, or the host is overloaded.

card.root_cause_question: Is any online runner serving this job's runs-on label, and is the host inside its CI budget?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Point the workflow at a served label (jack-ci-x64) or restore the runner; drain overflow when the host is over budget (playbook 16).
card.guard: ci-starved/ci-stuck guard + risk matrix label-coverage check

ci-disk-slow.desc: Storage latency (fsync) inside CI makes database-heavy tests time out.

card.root_cause_question: Is it the guest mount options, host I/O contention or the storage pool?
card.smallest_safe_fix: nobarrier/commit=30 on the CI guest, or test DBs on tmpfs; find the competing writer on the host.
card.guard: fsync probe in every CI guest (limit 8 ms)

host-memory.desc: A host or guest runs out of memory: low MemAvailable, OOM kills, swapped seats.

card.root_cause_question: Which guest or process grew, and was it a seat running suites on the host?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Stop seat-run suites and drain CI overflow (playbook 16); never kill active CI jobs.
card.guard: hosts guard (10 GiB floor, OOM kills) + mem-guard on Jupiter

disk-full.desc: A disk is at or near its limit (production, NAS, Jupiter, Pro, mini).

card.root_cause_question: What grew, by how much per day, and is it regenerable?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Prune regenerable caches only; archive data to the NAS before pruning (playbook 08/16).
card.guard: disk thresholds + risk matrix days-to-full projection

network-address.desc: A service points at a dead address or name (the NAS .20 interface, MagicDNS, stale DNS), or a port is refused.

card.root_cause_question: Which config still holds the old address, and why didn't the address change reach it?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Move the reference to the live IP (IP-first rule) and verify end to end.

provider-outage.desc: A model provider refuses or fails for many seats: billing (402), entitlement (400 not supported), auth, rate limits.

card.root_cause_question: Billing, entitlement or auth? Is it one seat or the whole lab?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Mark the lab OUT in GUARDIAN.md §6, broadcast, re-hire on an ON lab; credential/billing steps go to a #refusal.
card.guard: provider guard (3+ seats, one signature) + daily probes

pulse-blind.desc: An orchestrating line stops watching: stale heartbeat, dead crons, errored or stuck seats, T3 down.

card.root_cause_question: Did the session die, did its crons expire, or is it blocked in a long foreground call?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Wake the line (SendMessage / Pulse Runner); re-create its crons; restart errored seats with their brief.

handoff-stalled.desc: Work waits on a person or line: approved PRs unmerged, WAIT_SENIOR, unread notes or messages.

card.root_cause_question: Was the signal not surfaced, or surfaced and not acted on?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Wake the owner; merge or answer; if the signal was invisible, fix the surface (pulse/guard).
card.guard: handoffs guard with two-stage Senior escalation

prod-down.desc: A production product fails its public health check.

card.root_cause_question: Is it the app, its worker, the host (disk/memory) or the edge?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Playbook 08: confirm, read-only cause, smallest reversible restore, post-fault sweep of the whole host.

auth-state.desc: Identity, pairing or licensing state goes wrong: revoked by a transient fault, lock convoys, expired pairs, sign-in failures.

card.root_cause_question: Did a transient fault get encoded as a terminal state?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Restore access; never encode transient faults as revoked.
card.guard: Sphere pool saturation probe; revocation counter (pending)

tls-config.desc: TLS certificates or edge routing config are wrong: expiring or mismatched certs, traefik-dynamic drift.

card.root_cause_question: Is a static cert shadowing ACME, or did a deploy change edge config?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Remove the stale static cert / restore mode 700; let ACME renew.
card.guard: served-cert expiry/validity per host; traefik-dynamic mode check

backup-failure.desc: A backup did not run, failed, or is older than its limit.

card.root_cause_question: Did the job fail, or did its target (NAS, listener, address) disappear?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Run the job to its interim target; fix the target; verify a restore.

process-discipline.desc: An agent breaks a working rule: timestamps ahead of the clock, forbidden models, merges past gates.

card.root_cause_question: Is the rule only written down? Move it to a lower ladder rung.
card.smallest_safe_fix: Correct the artifact; encode the rule as a check (playbook 18).
card.guard: senior-clock check; blocked-model check in the pulse

guard-defect.desc: GUARDIAN itself is wrong: a guard crashed, a false positive, a missed detection.

card.root_cause_question: Which assumption in the guard was wrong?
card.smallest_safe_fix: Fix the guard the same pulse (estate-guardian PR); add the case to the eval set.
